text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(............
The flowers decorating the staff room...
Did I remember to change their water?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I should have... but...
Oh dear—I can't quite remember.
Things were so hectic today...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If the water stays dirty...
The flowers might suffer, too.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry.
I'll go see it first thing tomorrow morning...!
Worrying so much about the flowers displayed in the staff room, Curren Bouquetd'or found herself unable to fall asleep...
